title: Mouse DRG paclitaxel candidate: a metadata audit and descriptive TPM brief
question: Can public mouse DRG transcriptomics support an interpretable paclitaxel-response contrast?

claims.text: GSE230454 and GSE230459 provide female SW mouse dorsal-root-ganglion RNA-seq control and Pax-titled sample groups, respectively.
claims.limitation: The group title is not a validated exposure label.

claims.text: Every GSE230459 sample treatment-protocol field says saline although the sample titles say Pax and the study article describes paclitaxel dosing.
claims.limitation: The exact samples cannot be assigned confidently to paclitaxel from the public metadata alone.

claims.text: The processed workbooks contain 48,431 aligned feature rows and four TPM sample columns per arm.
claims.limitation: The independence of the four sample columns has not been established.

claims.text: Among 14,119 features with control mean TPM at least one, 53.7% have positive and 46.3% negative descriptive log2(TPM + 1) ratios; the median ratio is +0.020.
claims.limitation: TPM ratios are compositional and do not constitute count-based differential expression.

claims.text: The predeclared cell-cycle, interferon, cholesterol-synthesis, and injury-signaling marker panels have mixed descriptive directions.
claims.limitation: This is not pathway enrichment or evidence for a shared drug-response program.

claims.text: Reconcile the eight GSM treatment records with the submitter and raw-data metadata before a replicate-aware count-based comparison.
claims.limitation: The reconciliation and count-based analysis have not been performed.
